title: Canvas Panel & Layout 📐
description: Master the Canvas Panel and automatic layout containers.

slides.title: The Canvas Panel 🖼️
slides.content:
# Your Drawing Board

The root of every Widget Blueprint is a **Canvas Panel**. It allows absolute positioning:

* Drag widgets anywhere.
* Set **Position** (X, Y) and **Size** (Width, Height) manually.
* Anchors control how widgets stretch when the screen resizes.

This is great for HUDs where elements need exact pixel positions.

quizData.question: Canvas Panel automatically arranges widgets in a grid.
quizData.explanation: Canvas Panel uses absolute positioning; for grids, use Grid Panel or Wrap Box.

slides.title: Anchors & Alignment ⚓
slides.content:
## Responsive Design

Anchors lock a widget to a corner or edge of its parent. Click the anchor icon (top‑left of widget) and choose a preset:

* Top‑Left (fixed position)
* Center (screen center)
* Full Stretch (fill parent)

Use anchors so your UI works on different screen sizes. Combine with **Offsets** for margins.

slides.title: Other Layout Panels 🧱
slides.content:
## Automatic Arrangement

For menus, lists, and inventories, use:

* **Horizontal Box** – arranges children left to right.
* **Vertical Box** – arranges top to bottom.
* **Grid Panel** – rows and columns.
* **Wrap Box** – wraps children when they exceed width.
* **Scroll Box** – adds scroll bars when content overflows.

These panels **stack** their children automatically. You don't need to set positions manually.

quizData.question: Which panel automatically aligns its children vertically?
quizData.explanation: Vertical Box stacks children top‑to‑bottom automatically.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use Size Box for Fixed Sizes

Wrap a widget in a **Size Box** to force a specific width/height. Useful for icons that shouldn't stretch.
